options.reason: The table is the canonical Cleveland angiography cohort assembled to predict angiographic heart-disease presence, and heart_disease_binary already encodes that presence/absence outcome, so binary classification on it is the evident task. The raw severity column num is the source from which the binary label was derived and would leak the answer, so it is excluded from features and listed as a leakage suspect.
options.title: binary

options.reason: If the scientific aim is graded severity of angiographic disease rather than mere presence, the five-level num column is the natural multiclass outcome and the derived binary flag must then be treated as leakage.
options.title: multiclass
